kb.animals.foot and mouth.prevention: Goma zonke izilwane ezithintekayo njalo ngonyaka. Ukuvimbela ukuhamba kwezilwane, abantu nezimoto. Gcina ukuphepha okuqinile kwezinto eziphilayo. Yazisa ngokushesha i-DVS nganoma yiziphi izimo ezisolisayo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.duration: Sekuphele isikhathi esingakanani uqaphela lezi zimpawu?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating: Ingabe isilwane sidla futhi siphuze ngendlela evamile?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva: Ingabe kukhona ukuhlanza ngokweqile noma ukuhlanza okuvela emlonyeni?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread: Ingabe ezinye izilwane emhlambini zibonisa izimpawu ezifanayo?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.high: UKUQALA: Izinkomba eziqinile zesifo sezinyawo nomlomo. Hlukanisa zonke izilwane ngokushesha. Shayela umugqa ophuthumayo we-DVS ngokushesha. Ungahambi nezilwane, izimoto noma abantu phakathi kwamapulazi. Lesi yisifo sikazwelonke esiphuthumayo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.low: Izimpawu zakuqala zatholakala. Ukuze uvikeleke, gcina lesi silwane sihlukanisiwe nemihlambi. Landelela eduze amahora angu-24 alandelayo. Hlola zonke ezinye izilwane ukuze ubone izimpawu ezifanayo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.medium: Ukukhathazeka okulinganiselayo. Hlukanisa lesi silwane ngokushesha. Xhumana nehhovisi lakho lendawo le-DVS noma lezilwane zingakapheli amahora angu-24. Ningadlulisi noma yiziphi izilwane epulazini. I-FMD iyisifo esibikwayo, ngokomthetho kudingeka ukuba usibike.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.treatment: Ayikho ikhambi eliqondile le- FMD. Ukwelashwa kuyasekela: ukuhlanza nokubulala amagciwane amanxeba, ukunikeza ukudla okuthambile namanzi ahlanzekile, ukusebenzisa imithi elwa nokuvuvukala ngaphansi kokuqondisa kwezilwane, nokugcina izilwane zikhululekile.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.visual_symptom: Ama-blisters nezilonda emathangeni, emlonyeni, olimini nasebele. Ukuhlanza ngokweqile. Ukubekezela.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.when_to_call_v: Shayela udokotela wezilwane noma i-DVS ngokushesha. I-FMD iyisifo esibikwayo. Ungalindi.
kb.animals.goat pox.prevention: Umuthi wokugoma waminyaka yonke. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezilwane ezintsha okungenani amasonto amathathu. Gwema ukuxhumana nemihlambi ethelelekile. Gcina izindlu zihlanzekile futhi unciphise ukugcwala kwabantu.
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing: Ingabe lesi silwane sinenkinga yokuphefumula noma siyaphuma emakhaleni?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals: Ingabe kunezilwane ezintsha ezisanda kwethulwa emhlambini?
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.high: Ukuqubuka okukhulu kwe-Goat Pox. Udinga ukubonana nesilwane esiphuthumayo. Hlukanisa umhlambi wonke ekuxhumaneni kwangaphandle. Qala ukugoma izilwane ezingathintwanga ngokushesha. Yazisa iziphathimandla zezilwane zendawo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.low: Ukulimala esigabeni sokuqala. Hlukanisa isilwane esithintekile. Hlola ezinye izimbuzi eduze. Ukuqinisekisa izindlu ezihlanzekile nokunciphisa ukucindezeleka kwezilwane.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.medium: Isifo se- Goat Pox esisebenzayo. Hlukanisa zonke izilwane ezithintekile. Xhumana nodokotela wezilwane ukuze uthole ukwelashwa okulwa namagciwane kanye nokugoma izilwane eziphilile. Hlanza izindlu nemishini. Ukuvimbela ukuhamba kwezilwane.
kb.animals.goat pox.spreads_by: Ukuxhumana okuqondile, uketshezi lokuphefumula, imishini engcolisiwe
kb.animals.goat pox.treatment: Ukwelashwa okusekelayo kuphela. Imithi elwa namagciwane inganikezwa udokotela wezilwane. Hlanza futhi ubulale izifo nsuku zonke. Nikeza ukudla okunomsoco namanzi ahlanzekile. Izilwane ezincane ezihlukaniswe nabantu abadala njengezingane zibuthakathaka kakhulu.
kb.animals.goat pox.visual_symptoms: Ukulimala kwesikhumba okuphakanyisiwe ezindaweni ezingenazinwele; ngaphakathi ezindlebeni, emathunjini, emathunjini, eduze kwamehlo nasemlonyeni. Izilonda zihamba zisuka emabala abomvu aphakanyisiwe ziye kuma - vesicles zize zibe izikhumba ezinamagobolondo.
kb.animals.goat pox.when_to_call_vet: Xhumana nodokotela wezilwane kungakapheli amahora angu-24. Shayela ngokushesha uma kuvela izinkinga zokuphefumula noma uma izilonda zitheleleka kakhulu.
kb.animals.healthy.prevention: Gcina imithi yokugoma njalo, ukubulala izinambuzane, ukulawula izimonyo nokuhlolwa kwezilwane minyaka yonke.
kb.animals.healthy.rec.low: Isilwane sakho sibonakala sinempilo! Nikeza amanzi ahlanzekile, ukudla okulinganiselayo, nokulawula izilokazane njalo (ukubulala izinambuzane, ukwelashwa kwamathanga). Gcina imithi yokugoma isesikhathini futhi uhlele ukuhlolwa kwezilwane njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha.
kb.animals.healthy.visual_symptoms: Azikho izimpawu zesifo ezitholakalayo. Isilwane sibonakala sinempilo.
kb.animals.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Hlela ukuhlolwa okuvamile njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Shayela ngokushesha uma ubona ushintsho olungazelelwe ekuziphatheni, ekudleni, ekuhambeni noma ekubukekeni.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.prevention: Umuthi wokugoma waminyaka yonke ngomuthi wokugoma obhalisiwe we-LSD. Gcina izinhlelo zokulawula izinambuzane. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezilwane ezintsha izinsuku ezingu-28. Gwema ukuhambisa izilwane phakathi nokuqubuka.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever: Ingabe isilwane sizizwa sishisa uma sisithinta noma sibonakala sinokushisa?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.insects: Ingabe uye waphawula izinambuzane eziningi ezizungeze izilwane zakho muva nje?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.milk: Ingabe ukukhiqizwa kobisi kuye kwehla kakhulu?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.nodules_s: Kuzo zonke izingxenye zomzimba kuhlanganise nobuso nemilenze
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.high: Ukuvezwa kwesifo sesikhumba esinzima. Udinga ukubonisana nezilwane ngokushesha. Hlukanisa zonke izilwane ezithintekile. Qala ukulawula izinambuzane ngokhahlo epulazini. Goma izilwane ezingathinteki. Dweba futhi uthathe izithombe zawo wonke amacala.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.low: Kutholakale ama-nodule athambile. Hlukanisa isilwane futhi usilandele nsuku zonke. Faka izinto ezibulala izinambuzane kuzo zonke izilwane. Hlola ezinye izinkomo ukuthola ama-nodule afanayo. Xhumana nodokotela wezilwane uma izimpawu ziba zimbi kungakapheli amahora angu-48.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.medium: Ama-nodule amaningi anezinguquko zokuziphatha. Zihlukanise ngokushesha. Qala ukunakekelwa okusekelayo, imithi elwa nokuvuvukala, ukunakekelwa kwamasosha avulekile, ukulawula izimpukane. Xhumana nodokotela wezilwane kungakapheli amahora angu-24 ukuze uqinisekise ukuxilongwa kanye nohlelo lokwelashwa.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Ukulunywa yizinambuzane (izimpukane, izimpukane, ama-ticks), ukuxhumana okuqondile
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.treatment: Akukho ukwelashwa okuqondile kwe- antiviral okukhona. Ukunakekelwa okuwusizo kuhlanganisa: imithi elwa nokuvuvukala, ama-antibiotic okuvimbela ukutheleleka kwesibili, ukugqoka izilonda ezivulekile, nokudla okunempilo. Ukulawula izinambuzane kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusabalala.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.visual_symp: Izingwegwe zesikhumba eziyindilinga eziphakanyisiwe 2-5 cm kuwo wonke umzimba. Ama-nodule angase akhiphe uketshezi. Ama-lymph node athuthukile abonakala entanyeni nasemilenzeni.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.when_to_cal: Xhumana nodokotela wezilwane kungakapheli amahora angu-24. Shayela ngokushesha uma isilwane siyeka ukudla, siba nomkhuhlane omkhulu, noma ama-nodule avulekile futhi atheleleke.
kb.plants.healthy.prevention: Gcina ukulawula ukhula, ubheke izilokazane masonto onke, uqinisekise ukuchitheka kahle kwamanzi, usebenzise izinhlobonhlobo eziqinile lapho zitholakala, futhi ushintshe izitshalo ngesizini ngayinye.
kb.plants.healthy.rec.low: Isitshalo sakho sibonakala sinempilo! Qhubeka nokuqapha njalo. Qinisekisa ukuchelela okuhambisanayo, ukuvundiswa okulinganiselayo, ukugeleza kahle nokulawula ukhula. Hlola izilokazane nezifo masonto onke, futhi ushintshe izitshalo ngesizini ngayinye.
kb.plants.healthy.visual_symptoms: Azikho izimpawu zesifo ezitholakalayo. Lesi sitshalo sibonakala sinempilo, sinombala ovamile weqabunga nokukhula.
kb.plants.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Xhumana nesiphathimandla sezolimo uma uphawula ukufiphala, ukufiphala, izindawo ezingavamile noma ukulimala, ukubola, noma umsebenzi obalulekile wezinambuzane.
kb.plants.potato late blight.prevention: Sebenzisa amazambane embewu aqinisekisiwe, angenazo izifo. Izinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo ezingamelana nokulimala. Inhlabathi yezintaba phezu kwemigqa ukuze ivikele ama-tubers asathuthuka kuma-spore. Sebenzisa i-fungicide yokuvimbela ngaphambi kwesimo sezulu esimanzi. Ukujikeleza kwezitshalo kweminyaka emithathu ngezitshalo ezingezona ezomile.
Kupholile, kunomswakama futhi kunamafu izinsuku eziningana
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.spread_sp: Ukusabalala okusheshayo kakhulu kungakapheli amahora angu-24 kuya kwangu-48
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.tuber_aff: Lapho ukhipha ama-tubers, ingabe kukhona ukubola noma ukushintsha kombala?
Azikho izinhlayiya ezihlolwe noma zonke zibukeka zilungile
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.high: ISIHLOKO: Kudingeka isinyathelo esiphuthumayo. Sebenzisa i-fungicide yesistimu ngokushesha, noma omise futhi uvune amagilebhisi kusenesikhathi ukuvimbela ama-spore ukuba afinyelele emahlumela. Amahlumela avunwa kuphela uma amaqabunga efile futhi inhlabathi isomile ngandlela - thile. Ungagcini izimpungushe ezibonisa izimpawu zokubola. Ungatshali amazambane noma utamatisi kule ndawo okungenani izinyanga ezimbili.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.low: Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala. Sebenzisa ngokushesha i-fungicide noma i-mancozeb esezingeni lethusi. Susa amaqabunga atheleleke. Thuthukisa ukujikeleza komoya phakathi kwezitshalo. Gwema ukumanzisa amaqabunga lapho unisela. Hlola nsuku zonke, ikakhulukazi ngemva kwemvula.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.medium: Ukulimala okuqhubekayo kwamazambane. Faka i- fungicide yesistimu (i- metalaxyl noma i- cymoxanil) njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-5-7. Misa ukuchelela okuphezulu. Susa futhi ubhubhise zonke izitshalo ezithintekile kude nensimu. Gwema ukuvuna ama-tubers enhlabathini emanzi, ngoba lokhu kusakaza ama-spores kuwo wonke ama-tubers anempilo.
kb.plants.potato late blight.spreads_by: Ama-spore adluliselwa ngumoya, ama-water splash, ama-tubers embewu athelelekile, izimila ezithelelekile
kb.plants.potato late blight.treatment: Ama-fungicide afanayo ne-tomato late blight: i-metalaxyl, i-cymoxanil, i-fenamidone yesenzo sokuphulukisa. I- Mancozeb ne-chlorothalonil ukuze kuvikelwe. Njalo shintshanisa imikhiqizo ukuvimbela ukumelana nama-fungicide. Zilungise izimpaphe ezivunwe (ukugcinwa ezomile nokuphefumulelwe kahle) ngaphambi kokugcinwa kwesikhathi eside ukuze kuncishiswe ukusakazeka kokugqwala.
kb.plants.potato late blight.visual_symp: Izilonda ezinamafutha ezimanzi amnyama emaqabungeni, ngokuvamile ziqala emaphethelweni amaqabunga. Isikhunta esimhlophe esibonakala ezansi kweqabunga ezimweni ezimanzi. Izilonda ezimnyama ezigxotsheni. Ama-tuber abonisa ukubola okubomvu okwesibhakabhaka ngaphansi kwesikhumba futhi angakwazi ukubola nakakhulu lapho egcinwa. Izitshalo zingawa zingakapheli izinsuku ezimweni ezimanzi.
kb.plants.potato late blight.when_to_cal: Xhumana nomphathi wezokuthuthukiswa kwezolimo ngokushesha. I-potato late blight ingabhubhisa isivuno sonke, kokubili amaqabunga namaqabunga agcinwe, ngezinsuku ezimbalwa ezimweni ezipholile, ezimanzi  zisebenza ngokushesha.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.prev: Izinhlobonhlobo ze-sorghum ezikhuthazwa isikhunta ezitshalweni. Faka i-fungicide esigabeni sokuqhakaza esingu-50%. Vuna ngokushesha lapho uvuthiwe. Gwema ukuhlwanyela sekwephuzile okuphoqa ukuvuna kuze kube yisikhathi semvula. Ukuqinisekisa izimo ezifanele zokugcina okusanhlamvu.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.ha: Ingabe isivuno sesilungele ukuvunwa noma sesivuthiwe?
Kusasele amasonto amabili kuya kwamane ngemva kokuvuna
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.we: Sasinjani isimo sezulu phakathi nesikhathi sokugcwaliswa kokusanhlamvu nokuvuthwa?
Isikhunta sezinhlamvu esibucayi. Ukuvunwa ngokushesha kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kunjani ukuvuthwa. Ukusanhlamvu okwenziwe ngobuningi akufanele ukusetshenziswa ngabantu noma ekudleni kwezilwane ngenxa yama-mycotoxins. Xhumana ne-Agricultural Extension ukuze uthole izeluleko zokulahla okusanhlamvu. Umthombo wezinhlobonhlobo ezimelana nesikhunta zonyaka ozayo.

Izimpawu zokuqala zesikhunta ezitholakalayo. Uma sekuseduze nokuvunwa, kuvunwe kusenesikhathi ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusakazeka. Qinisekisa ukujikeleza komoya okuhle okuzungeze amakhanda okusanhlamvu. Sebenzisa i-fungicide uma isivuno sisese emasontweni ambalwa ngaphambi kokuvuna futhi izimo zihlala zimanzi.

Isikhunta sezinhlamvu esilinganiselwe. Ukuvuna ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka  ungalindi. Imbewu evundile eyomile ngokushesha ibe ngaphansi kuka-13% umswakama. Hlukanisa okusanhlamvu okunesikhunta nokusanhlamvu okunempilo. Unganikeli izilwane ukudla okusanhlamvu okunomswakama osindayo ngoba ama-micotoxin angaba yingozi.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.spre: Ama-fungal spores athwalwa umoya nemvula, ukulimala kwezinambuzane kokusanhlamvu kudala izindawo zokungena
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.trea: Uma sekusungulwe isikhunta sezinhlamvu, i-fungicide inomphumela omncane. Ukusetshenziswa kwefungicide yokuvimbela ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza (isb. i-propiconazole) kuyasebenza kakhulu. Ukuvuna kusenesikhathi ngezikhathi zemvula. Gcina okusanhlamvu kunomswakama ongaphansi kuka-13% ukuze kugwenywe isikhunta emva kokuvuna.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.visu: Umbala ophuzi, obomvu, ophuzi noma omnyama emakhanda okusanhlamvu. Izinhlamvu zomkhiqizo ngamunye ziyancipha noma ziyashintsha umbala. Ukukhula kwesikhunta okumhlophe noma okumsulwa okubonakala phakathi kwezinhlamvu zembewu.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.when: Xhumana nesikhulu sakho sezolimo noma uMnyango Wezolimo uma isikhunta sithinta ngaphezu kuka-30% wesivuno sakho noma uma usola ukungcola kwe-mycotoxin.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.prevention: Sebenzisa izinhlobonhlobo zamatamatisi ezingangcoliswa. Hlanganisa izitshalo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukujikeleza komoya. Sebenzisa ukunkcenkceshela. Sebenzisa i-fungicide yokuvimbela ngaphambi kwesimo sezulu esimanzi. Ukujikeleza kwezitshalo kweminyaka emithathu ngezitshalo ezingezona ezomile.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.q.fruit_aff: Ingabe izithelo nazo zibonisa izimpawu zokubola noma zokulimala?
Kupholile, kunomswakama futhi kunamafu izinsuku eziningana

Susa futhi ushise zonke izinsalela zezitshalo. Ungahlwanyeli utamatisi noma amazambane kule ndawo okungenani izinyanga ezimbili. Hlanza izinsimbi nemishini.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.rec.low: Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala. Sebenzisa ngokushesha i-fungicide noma i-mancozeb esezingeni lethusi. Susa amaqabunga atheleleke. Thuthukisa ukujikeleza komoya. Gwema ukumanzisa amaqabunga lapho unisela. Hlola nsuku zonke.

Vuna noma isiphi isithelo esivuthiwe ngokushesha ngaphambi kokuba sihlakazeke. Susa yonke impahla yezitshalo ethelelekile ensimini bese uyibhubhisa.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.spreads_by: Ama-spore adluliselwa umoya, ukuchitheka kwamanzi, izimila ezithathelwanayo

Izithelo zibonisa ukubola okuqinile okwesibhakabhaka kusuka ngaphandle kuya ngaphakathi. Izitshalo zingawa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa.

kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.preven: Izinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo ezimelana namagciwane. Sebenzisa i-mulch yesiliva egxilile ukuze udideke ama- aphids. Sebenzisa izibulala-zinambuzane zokuzivikela. Susa futhi ubhubhise ukhula oluzungeze insimu. Gwema ukutshala eduze kwamasimu e-cucurbit atheleleke.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.aphi: Uyabona yini izinambuzane ezincane ezansi kwamaqabunga?
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.frui: Izithelo zincane, zonakele noma zinesikhumba esishwabene
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.hi: Ukuqubuka okunzima endaweni yonke. Susa futhi ushise zonke izitshalo ezithintekile. ZINGAqediwe. Faka umuthi wokubulala izinambuzane. Ungahlwanyeli izitshalo ze-cucurbit kule nsimu okungenani isizini eyodwa. Imithombo yezinhlobonhlobo ezingamelana namagciwane ezisetshenziselwa ukutshala kabusha.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.lo: Izimpawu zokuqala ze-mosaic virus ezitholakala ezitshalweni ezimbalwa. Susa futhi ubhubhise amaqabunga athintekile. Sebenzisa umuthi wokubulala izinambuzane ukulawula ama-aphid vectors. Ungasebenzisi izitshalo ezinempilo ngemva kokuthinta izitshalo ezithintekile ngaphandle kokugeza izandla. Hlola ezinye izitshalo nsuku zonke.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.me: Ukusabalala kwe-mosaic virus okulinganiselayo. Susa zonke izitshalo ezithathelwe igciwane futhi uzibhubhise zisuswe ensimini. Gcoba izitshalo ezisele nge-insecticide enconyelwe yokulawula i-aphid. Ungaphinde utshale ama-cucurbits kule ndawo kule sizini. Cabanga nge-mulch ecasulayo ukuze uvimbele ama- aphids.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.spread: Izinambuzane ze-Aphid, impahla yezitshalo ethelelekile, amathuluzi okuhlinza
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.treatm: Ayikho indlela yokwelapha izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Ukuphathwa kuphela: susa izitshalo ezithintekile, ulawule ama-aphid vectors nge-insecticide (isb. i-imidacloprid, i-pyrethroids), sebenzisa ama-mulch abukhali, kanye nezinhlobonhlobo ezimelana nezitshalo esikhathini esizayo.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.visual: I-mosaic eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka igcwele amaqabunga. Ukuhlanekezelwa kwamaqabunga nokugoqa. Izithelo ezinombala ongalingani, usayizi omncane noma indawo eneziqu. Ukukhula kwezitshalo okuphazamisekile.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.when_t: Xhumana nesiphathimandla sezokwanda kwezolimo uma izitshalo zakho ezingaphezu kuka-20% zithintekile, noma uma udinga usizo lokuthola umuthi wokubulala izinambuzane ofanele.
